decision: Runtime interlocks are primary; a hit invalidates data and holds then aborts HOST_ERROR. Exact rotation/multi-body swept-path proof is not required.

v89_translation_source.qualification: Coordinator-specified assumptions, not an independently qualified motion model.

integration: All absolute command leases in [0,370] seconds, including steps and PRBS; no sign cancellation anywhere. Initial hold, coasts and camera/arm tail remain in this window.
geometry: Robot/arm bound 0.40 m; yaw tip translation <= R*min(total_abs_yaw,2). Loaded: tip radius = max(0.40, chassis-to-beam-centre + beam half-diagonal); add half-diagonal to both carrier discs. Beam-start disc encloses both carrier discs.
qualification: Conditional preflight for simulation-only teacher data. Does not qualify loaded/fine/turn calibration, hardware safety, P03, carry, or E2E.
